verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a docs page titled "Nitrokey Provisioning for Entra ID" (title only, mechanism unknown) and the nitropy CLI, which interacts with devices locally and could at most script on-device setup. Probes found no OpenAPI or enterprise API surface, and nothing covers ordering or assignment. Missing for 10: documented enterprise ordering API, user/key assignment API, a programmatic pre-registration API with documented details, an API spec or agent-facing docs, and independent corroboration.
